Distributor Declaration - Ethical Practices & Compliance

I/We Distributor Company Name hereby declare that I/We have undergone and understood training provided on Ethical Practices and compliance. As a distributor of Meril, I/We acknowledge and accept the duty to comply with the procedural frameworks developed and adopted by the Meril’s Management from time to time. I/We have been thoroughly informed on the various Code of Conduct that govern the ethical operation of Meril’s business, which I/We agree to follow diligently.
I/We have read, understood and consent to abide by the following Codes of Conduct on a consensus-ad-idem basis:

  1. Anti Bribery and Anti Corruption Policy
  2. Export Controls and Trade Sanctions Policy
  3. HCP & HCO Compliance framework
  4. National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority norms for capping of maximum retail price & maximum trade margin across all trade channels
  5. FCPA (Foreign Corrupt Practices Act)

I/We further affirm and declare that, except for the current distributorship agreement, I/we have no direct or indirect familial, financial, or other relationships with any employee, their family member, relative, or nominated representative of the Meril Group, or with any entity within the Meril Group. Should I/we become aware of any such relationship in the future, I/we commit to disclosing it to Meril within thirty (30) days from the date of awareness Additionally, I/We affirm and declare that I/we will not engage in any financial transactions with any employee, their family member, relative or nominated representative of the Meril Group. I/We acknowledge that Meril Group shall bear no responsibility or liability for any such transactions.

I/We agree to fully comply with all ethical standards and behavioral expectations as outlined in the applicable Codes of Conduct and related policies. I/We understand that any actual or potential violation of these Codes or policies may constitute grounds for disciplinary action, including, but not limited to, termination of the Distributorship Agreement I/We certify that I/We am/are not currently in violation of any of the aforementioned Codes of Conduct
